description: Garmin activity upload job: statuses, operation phases, lease classes, timers and transitions. Status and phase strings are persisted verbatim and must round-trip through backup/migration.

statuses.Pending: Waiting for AvailableAtUtc; leasable when AttemptCount < 3, account enabled + Connected, and no unsettled H10 recording for the session.
statuses.InFlight: Leased by one worker until LeaseExpiresAtUtc (lease = 2 minutes).
statuses.Confirmed: Terminal success. Phase 'Upload' for a plain upload or a completed merge; 'UndoComplete' after Undo merge.
statuses.FoundInGarmin: Terminal. PreferWatch strong match (FailureKind 'watch-match', AcknowledgedAtUtc set), or user acknowledgment of an Unknown job.
statuses.ReviewRequired: Terminal until the user acts. Phase 'Review', FailureKind 'review-required'. Never retried automatically or by the normal retry action.
statuses.Failed: Known failure. CanRetry only for FailureKind provider | provider-unavailable | duplicate, or merge-source while phase WatchSearch and no remote IDs. Authentication failures need reconnect and are dismiss-only.
statuses.Unknown: A mutation may have reached Garmin. Never retried automatically or by the normal retry action.
statuses.Dismissed: Terminal, user-dismissed (from Failed, Unknown or ReviewRequired).

phases.notes: A read-only phase may still end in a mutation, but only after persisting a switch to the matching mutation phase under the current lease (compare-and-set on LeaseExpiresAtUtc). DeleteOriginal is entered as a pending phase, so an expired DeleteOriginal lease becomes Unknown even if the delete was never sent (conservative).

leaseExpiry.readOnlyPhase: Status Pending, AttemptCount = max(0, AttemptCount - 1), AvailableAtUtc = now, LastError cleared, lease cleared.
leaseExpiry.mutationPhase: Status Unknown, LastError 'The service restarted or timed out after a Garmin mutation may have begun; the outcome is unknown and will not be retried automatically.'
leaseExpiry.exception: An Unknown job in phase ReplacementUpload with MatchedRemoteId set, no RemoteId/ReplacementRemoteId, on an enabled Connected MergeAndReplace account, whose retained original+merged backup pair exists for that same original ID, is automatically moved to Pending/ResolveReplacement (read-only resolution, never a second upload). Scanned at the start of every worker pass, at most 25 jobs.

timers.workerPass: every 1 minute, or immediately on a wake signal
timers.initialDelay: AvailableAtUtc = session EndedAt + 5 minutes (normal); now (synthetic test)
timers.attemptsCap: AttemptCount < 3 to lease; a non-auth failure at AttemptCount >= 3 becomes Failed instead of Pending
timers.resolutionChecks: ResolveReplacement / ResolveRestoredOriginal / ResolveRestoredLocal after an upload without ID: first check at +2 minutes, then +5, then +10; after the third unsuccessful check => Unknown
timers.verifyResyncAfterDuplicateCleanup: +2 minutes when the original was already gone; immediately after DeleteOriginal

transitions.sets: AttemptCount + 1, LeaseExpiresAt = now + 2 min (atomic compare-and-set on Status + AttemptCount)
RemoteId = MatchedRemoteId = candidate, FailureKind watch-match, AcknowledgedAt = now, token refreshed

transitions.to: download original, back up original + local + merged FIT, then InFlight/ReplacementUpload

transitions.event: merge validation fails before any mutation
confirmed without ID, or unknown, or timeout/ambiguous
retained merged copy proven among canonical candidates
a canonical candidate lacks FIT proof, or a semantic match spans several retained categories

transitions.to: Pending (+5/+10 min) or Unknown after 3 checks
InFlight/ReplacementUpload: upload the retained merged FIT once

transitions.event: each extra canonical copy proven generated
replacement and original both FIT-verified, delete confirmed
replacement verified; any watch-recreated original proven by FIT is deleted (phase DeleteResyncedOriginal)

transitions.from: any status except Pending/InFlight (requires the retained backup pair and an enabled Connected account)

transitions.to: InFlight/RestoreOriginal: upload retained original FIT once
InFlight/RestoreLocal: upload retained local FIT once

transitions.event: both kept sources freshly verified, nothing else to delete

retryPhaseMapping.override: If the account is enabled, Connected, MergeAndReplace, and the job has no MatchedRemoteId and no ReplacementRemoteId => WatchSearch. A ProviderUnavailable account returns to Connected.

accountStates.NeedsAuthentication: set by any authentication failure; jobs stop leasing until reconnect
accountStates.ProviderUnavailable: set when the Garmin client is unavailable (feature flag off / module broken); a retry resets it to Connected
